city_status.summary_sr: Vazduh je nezdrav za osetljive grupe građana.
city_status.summary_en: Air is unhealthy for sensitive groups.

superintelligence_monologue.speaker: Povezivač
superintelligence_monologue.text_sr: Skeptic is right that paired arrival proves nothing about measurement time, but the pairing itself moved: SEPA and citizen sensors both received 6 min ago [F2][F4], while Parking Servis lags at 16 min [F5]. What I connect now is the hour and the garage: free spaces at Obilićev venac rose from 292 to 412 within the window [F6], at 03:39 on a Monday [F1], the night the feeds fill with election headlines [F9][F20]. Meanwhile Blic shows 0 of 96 expected slots [F26], yet a similarity link still points at a Blic headline about cable theft stopping trains [F39] - the feed and the archive disagree.
